title: MV Game With Custom Made Resources Only

posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body:
So, I'm also an artist and composer. The idea is just that. use the basic features of RPG Maker MV, without any custom scripts, but with the whole art custom made. The goal is to make a game in RPG Maker that doesn't seem to be made in the maker at first glance, but that can be recognized as a RPG Maker one by who knows the engine well.
I presume it will take a lot of time to work into everything, so I thought about a short game. I don't have much ideas however about the style of the game, if I should go for something like Final Fantasy or Dragon Quest. Besides that, I don't want to just "rework" the basic tilesets to resemble the RPG Maker ones.
Also, I'm willing to do something with the "Porradaria" title, since I have two released games with this title and could cater to previous players, although the title itself doesn't make sense for non Portuguese speaking players. I though of something like "The Legend of Porradaria".

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Without any plugins or custom scripts your game will still feel like an RPG Maker game. That is a common complaint I've seen: All RPG Maker games FEEL the same.
If all you change are the graphics and music it may not look like an RPG Maker game at first glance but it will still play like one.
